paragraphs.text: Titus was a Human Knight from Eldraine .

Titus was a young red-headed knight from Castle Ardenvale . He was a romantic interest of both Rowan and Will Kenrith . He was the only person from their cohort who could regularly defeat Rowan at swordwork. Titus could magically cast a net of confidence that was amplified the more fighters it cloaked.
Titus was killed by a lich lord in the Wilds during the quest to find Algenus Kenrith .
